title: WaterColor 20 Goldenrod Circle #302
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 6 amenity access bands.**- Located in the Towncenter District of WaterColor- Access to community pools, nature trails, and dune lakes- Conveniently located near Publix & restaurants- Balcony with Gulf views- Washer/Dryer- 3 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Prime Location!! Gulf View!! Sophisticated style reigns in this multi-family residence with accommodations for six in our Beach District. Inside, a neutral background allows the artwork to shine while the Gulf takes center stage outside. The living room is furnished with a beautiful white queen-sleeper sofa, four comfortable lounge chairs, and an entertainment area with an oversized flatscreen smart tv. The dining area features a whitewashed table that seats six. Honey-toned cabinets and stainless steel appliances provide a nice atmosphere for cooking in the kitchen. The serene mood continues in the primary bedroom, where the king bed faces a large flatscreen smart tv and natural light from the large balcony. The private bath has a double vanity, jetted tub, and walk-in shower. The guest bedroom is furnished with a queen bed, bunk beds, and a flatscreen smart tv. This bedroom adjoins a bath with a walk-in shower and single vanity. A furnished balcony with partial but beautiful Gulf views is accessed via glass doors from the living room and the primary bedroom. This residence is just STEPS away from the Beach Club and only one block from Town Center shopping and dining!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Room: Queen SleeperWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
